name: io.github.cubinet-code/paperless-ngx-mcp
title: Paperless-ngx
description: Full Paperless-ngx API for AI assistants: search, tag, edit and upload documents, workflows and more

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance, e.g. https://paperless.example.com

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Paperless-ngx API token (My Profile → generate token)

environmentVariables.name: PAPERLESS_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Public URL used for browser links to documents. Defaults to PAPERLESS_URL.
